## Settlement Overview

On June 02, 2026, UroGen Pharma announced a settlement with Teva Pharmaceuticals to resolve a patent conflict over its cancer treatment, Jelmyto. The settlement and license agreement resolves ongoing U.S. patent litigation over Jelmyto, which stemmed from Teva's attempt to secure FDA approval for a generic version before UroGen's patents expire.

## License Terms

Under the terms, Teva will obtain a non-exclusive license to market its generic version starting September 15, 2030, pending FDA approval. The Agreement is subject to review by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and the U.S. Department of Justice.

## Background

The agreement follows Teva's attempt to produce a generic version of the drug, which is approved for adults with low-grade upper tract urothelial cancer in the U.S. UroGen's revenue primarily comes from the sales of Jelmyto and another product, Zusduri, both of which are marketed in the United States.

- **ZUSDURI (mitomycin intravesical solution, formerly UGN-102)** — FDA-approved **June 12, 2025**; first/only drug for recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (LG-IR-NMIBC). This is the growth engine. ([Investors/UroGen](https://investors.urogen.com/news-releases/news-release-details/us-fda-approves-urogens-zusduritm-mitomycin-intravesical), 2025-06-12)
- **JELMYTO (mitomycin)** — approved for low-grade upper tract urothelial cancer; older product.
- Pipeline: **UGN-103** (next-gen mitomycin, same LG-IR-NMIBC indication) and **UGN-501** (entering Phase I).

**2. What drove the recent run (early-to-mid June 2026)** — NOT a PDUFA/FDA decision; the approval already happened in 2025. The move is a stack of incremental positives + sentiment, not one binary event:
- **May 15, 2026:** UGN-103 Phase 3 UTOPIA data — **94.5% six-month durability of response** (consistent with ZUSDURI's 91.9%); FDA agreement on NDA submission strategy. ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/15/3295788/0/en/UroGen-Reports-94-5-Six-Month-Duration-of-Response-in-Phase-3-UTOPIA-Trial-Advancing-UGN-103-Toward-Potential-Approval-in-Recurrent-Low-Grade-Intermediate-Risk-NMIBC.html), 2026-05-15)
- **June 2, 2026:** Teva patent settlement on Jelmyto — generic entry pushed to **Sept 15, 2030**, removing a near-term overhang. ([BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/urogen-announces-agreement-resolving-patent-litigation-relating-to-jelmyto-mitomycin-for-pyelocalyceal-solution) / [Bloomberg Law](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/pharma-and-life-sciences/urogen-pharma-teva-end-patent-dispute-over-urinary-cancer-drug), 2026-06-02)

ZUSDURI is already approved/selling; UGN-103 already has positive pivotal data consistent with the approved drug. The Q3 NDA submission is a filing milestone (low binary risk).
